radix.upside: Only a speculative one: community groups taking over the network before the Foundation's paid-for services run out at the end of December 2026 could restore confidence.
radix.cheap: Not mispriced so much as abandoned: the Foundation went into maintenance mode in April 2026 and the price is up about 140% since my first look with no news behind it.
radix.wrongIf: No community body announces it will run the gateway and wallet services before 2026-12-31, or the price gives back this week's 53% jump.
radix.vsScanner: The scanner sees a live code repo and a trading spike; I see a project whose backer is winding down, so the spike is speculation, not a signal.

numinous.upside: A real working product (AI forecasting agents competing on Bittensor, plus the Eversight tool) that could win more subnet rewards if it keeps beating benchmarks.
numinous.cheap: Subnet tokens are thinly traded and the whole Bittensor area has been shaken by governance drama, so small subnets get ignored.
numinous.wrongIf: Its share of Bittensor rewards falls or daily trading drops back under about $30K.
numinous.vsScanner: Agree it is alive, but a 6.7x trading spike with the price still falling 9% this week is not a reason to look.

cumulus-encrypted-storage-system.upside: A mainnet launch and token move to its own chain would be the real event, but it was promised for early 2026 and I can't find a new date.
cumulus-encrypted-storage-system.cheap: Storage coins are out of favour and only about a quarter of tokens are released, so buyers expect selling from future unlocks.
cumulus-encrypted-storage-system.wrongIf: No dated mainnet announcement by end of 2026, or a big unlock lands first.
cumulus-encrypted-storage-system.vsScanner: Scanner says alive and I agree, but it underweights the 74% of tokens still to come.

arbitrum.upside: Offchain Labs is buying ARB under an approved plan and the network keeps growing (Robinhood Chain over $1B locked), but there is no single dated event that should move the price.
arbitrum.cheap: Large Layer 2 coins have been sold steadily all year as supply keeps unlocking, so the market is not missing it so much as tired of it.
arbitrum.wrongIf: Price keeps making new lows after the 93M ARB unlock around 2026-11-15/16 even with the buybacks running.
arbitrum.vsScanner: Agree on the health numbers, but the scanner ignores the monthly unlock landing tomorrow, which is a headwind not a catalyst.

iexec-rlc.cheap: No clear reason; score has collapsed from 75 to 22.
iexec-rlc.wrongIf: Price keeps sliding with no announcement.
iexec-rlc.vsScanner: Scanner's own score now agrees the earlier interest is gone.

nervos-network.wrongIf: Price keeps sliding with no announcement.
nervos-network.vsScanner: Score fell from 56 to 18; agree with the scanner.

wormhole.wrongIf: Price makes new lows on its own news rather than the market.

starknet.cheap: Layer 2 coins are out of favour and keep unlocking supply.
